assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production UI icon atlas for anime pixel art JRPG. Landscape canvas 1536 by 1024, EXACTLY 6 columns by 4 rows, 24 equal square cells. Each cell holds ONE independent detailed pixel-art ability emblem, about 60 percent of cell width and height, centered, 20 percent transparent empty margins. Authentic rich 16-bit anime JRPG icon style, crisp pixel clusters, dark outlines, jewel-like highlights, hard cel-shading. Every icon must be strongly distinct and legible at 48px. No text, letters, numerals, interface frames, borders, gridlines, background, shadows outside icon, soft blur or gradients. TRUE transparent background. Read row-major left to right:
Row1: (1) green moss beetle shell shield, (2) violet serpent fangs dripping green poison, (3) silver wolf head with amber eyes and wind streak, (4) emerald healing sprout with ruby mushroom and healing spark, (5) pale cyan moth wing surrounded by curling mist, (6) turquoise water jet curling into sharp splash.
Row2: (1) gold firefly spark electric bolt, (2) crimson bat wing surrounding red life-drain droplet, (3) dark violet serpent mouth exhaling green toxic breath, (4) purple centipede with yellow paralysis zigzag, (5) slate-blue armored dinosaur plated shell, (6) white spider web with amber sticky droplet.
Row3: (1) living emerald shell with pink healing core (adaptive body), (2) skull-shaped purple toxic cloud (miasma), (3) turquoise spiral storm with golden lightning (conductive storm), (4) white cocoon bound by purple silk (silk prison), (5) crossing silver steel wire and blue water blade, (6) blue magical eye in a golden sigil.
Row4: (1) imposing green stone bastion shield with amber core, (2) three taut shining silver cutting threads, (3) golden reptilian eye with red heat waves, (4) violet concentric sound waves from bat ears, (5) sharp sapphire curved water sword, (6) muscular bronze fist with red power aura.
All cells precisely aligned; don't duplicate emblems. Reference NPC sheet is only for pixel outline and anime shading language, not subject.
assets.refinement: Edit the supplied game icon atlas. Preserve all 24 existing icon designs, colors, dark outlines and pixel-art details in EXACTLY the same row-major order. Fix layout and background only: exactly 6 equal columns and 4 equal rows. Reduce each icon to 65 percent of its cell width and height, centered, with generous completely transparent padding on all four sides of every cell. ALL original artwork must fit fully inside its own cell, never cross a cell boundary or touch cell edges. Remove colored gradient backplates and soft glows: empty space between and behind icons must be fully transparent alpha. Keep the actual icon interior opaque. No labels, frames or grid lines. Sheet landscape 1536 by 1024.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: actual animated friendly NPC sprite sheet for top-down anime pixel JRPG. Subject Myourmiles / Mjollmile, the human merchant from That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime: plump middle-aged man, bald top with short dark brown hair on sides, small dark moustache, round welcoming face, tiny narrow eyes, rich purple merchant vest/coat with gold edging over cream tunic, brown belt and boots, gold rings, small leather coin purse. Full adult body with compact stocky silhouette, not dwarf or goblin. Style MUST match reference Kaijin sheet: anime facial features, dark pixel outlines, visible crisp square pixel clusters, hard cel shading. EXACTLY 2 by 2 grid four equal square cells on square transparent canvas. Character no more than 55 percent of each cell height; center at cell x=50 percent, feet at cell y=80 percent. At least 80px fully transparent margin to EVERY cell edge, no touching centerlines or outer edges. Four poses same size and feet baseline: neutral hands on belt; friendly idle hand on chest; offering a small leather pouch; waving welcome. No scenic background, ground shadow, text, grid, labels, letters, watermark. True alpha transparency. Do not copy Kaijin's beard, hair or hammer.
